name: Danube Night Shift
description: A quiet server farm on the Danube relays the syndicate's traffic across Europe, and the night shift knows nothing. The guards know everything. Cross the bridge and shoot your way down the server hall, switching off its laser from afar, or dive into the Danube and swim into the cable duct below, where a USB key, a computer and a security door keep the way quiet. Both routes climb the east shaft to the roof, where the admin password waits on the water tank.
